Welcome to the neighborhood

Pull up
a chair.

Common Table is a membership club for neighbors who love to share — food, skills, stories, and a few hours of doing something that matters. No venue required. Just a table and good company.

Join the Table See Gatherings

127 members & counting · Gatherings every month

What we do

Four ways to gather

Every Common Table gathering is member-hosted, neighborhood-rooted, and wide open to whoever wants to come.

Potlucks

Bring a dish, leave with a recipe. Our potlucks happen in backyards, parks, and community rooms across the neighborhood.

Skill Shares

From sourdough to small engine repair — members teach what they love and learn what they don't know yet.

Reading Groups

One book, ten perspectives. Our reading circles meet at the library and in living rooms, and the conversation always outpaces the page count.

Volunteer Days

Mural painting, garden cleanups, food drives — we show up for the block that shows up for us. No experience required.
